jobs.occupation: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG: Experienced Customer Engineer (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
jobs.employer_name: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Summary of RoleGlobalFoundries Fab 1 in Dresden Germany is looking for a motivated and skilled experienced engineer to be a part of the Customer Engineering team. The primary responsibility in this role would be to work with customers to plan for their New Products in Fab1, align internally and run customer meetings where multiple technical items are discussed. A responsibility is also to track and move wafers across sites, OSATs to ship to our customers.Your JobPerform as technical conduit for Customer Programs from Customer Prototyping (NPI) to Product EOL- Act as primary Engineering channel ensuring crisp & clear communication.- Be the focal point for Customer communication to the Fab, aligning messaging internally and then sharing externally with the customer.- Work with the Fab1 Production Control, Planning and Product Integration to track internal dates and On Time Delivery (OTD) metrics.- Run customer meetings, ensuring action items are aligned and followed up.- Take ownership and drive any issue for the customer project to a solution, involving all required departments.- Interface with Account Managers (AM), Field Application Engineering (FAE), all sales teams and Customers to enable program success.- Achieve revenue goals and derive customer satisfaction.Required Qualifications- Education: 4 Year Technical / Bachelor/Master Degree in Science, Math, Engineering or Semiconductor Manufacturing.- Extensive experience in manufacturing or customer facing engineering role.- Proven track record of leading cross‑functional collaboration, driving alignment across diverse engineering teams, and influencing stakeholders at multiple levels.- Strong organizational skills with a focus on efficiency and accuracy.- Excellent interpersonal skills; fosters positive working relationships.- Capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing activities under pressure.- Fluency in English Language – written & verbal (C1).We Offer  The position is open-ended and to be filled as soon as possible.    Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden.  Flexible working time arrangements:   Family friendly part-time models, trust flextime, salary conversion into free time  Diverse opportunities for further development:   Career stages for every job, internal qualification offers, promotion of external educational qualifications  Focus on your health:   On-site gym and beach volleyball court, bike leasing, subsidized employee restaurant  Corporate culture:   Cooperation at eye level - everyone is on first name terms with us, budget for individual team events, social commitment via GlobalGives    You can find more benefits in detail at  hier  Diversity is part of our corporate DNA. For this reason, we would like to encourage women in particular to apply for a job with us. As we value equal opportunities and inclusion is particularly important to us, we welcome applications from people with disabilities.The job advertisement refers to a position up to job level 8 on the Engineering career ladder.This position is part of our employee referral program and will be rewarded with a referral bonus of €2,000 upon successful recruitment.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309351/experienced-customer-engineer (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309351/experienced-customer-engineer#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. Wir sind innovativ und arbeiten mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um energieeffizientere und leistungsfähigere Produkte für die Automobilindustrie, intelligente mobile Geräte, das Internet der Dinge (IoT), Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen und andere wachstumsstarke Märkte zu entwickeln.Mit unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk, das sich über die USA, Europa und Asien erstreckt, sind wir eine vertrauenswürdige und zuverlässige Quelle für Kunden in aller Welt. Jeden Tag liefert unser talentiertes und vielfältiges Team Ergebnisse mit einem unnachgiebigen Fokus auf Sicherheit, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. GF beschäftigt weltweit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitende, davon 3.000 in Dresden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.gf.com.

jobs.description: Job DescriptionJob SummaryResponsible for providing on-site service and commissioning of semiconductor equipment, ensuring adherence to safety standards and specifications.Key Responsibilities :- Support the service and commissioning of semiconductor equipment, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards and specifications.- Conduct thorough testing and troubleshooting of equipment to identify and resolve any issues that may arise during the start-up process.- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, and production staff, to ensure smooth and efficient equipment start-up.- Optimise equipment performance and make necessary adjustments to achieve desired production targets.- Maintain start-up procedures, checklists, and documentationSkills & Knowledge- Qualification in Engineering, Electronics or related field or related experience- Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues.- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.- Basic understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment.- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with customers and team members.- Willingness to travel and work in shift system- Valid driver’s licenseIndividual pay is determined based on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skills, job-related knowledge, relevant education, certifications, and/or training. In addition to base salary, we offer (full time regular employees ) a comprehensive benefits package and for certain roles eligibility in our bonus plan and long-term incentives as applicable. The talent advisor can share more details about total compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.Tokyo Electron Limited (TEL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). As such, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, belief, gender, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, membership to a traveller community or any other legally protected characteristic. TEL acknowledges that diversity creates an innovative culture and aims to create a workplace where everyone is treated fairly and can succeed based on merit and qualifications.SubsidiaryTokyo Electron Europe Ltd.Schlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309337/field-service-engineer-ct-strich-sps (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309337/field-service-engineer-ct-strich-sps#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenKarriere bei Tokyo Electron: Gemeinsam die Zukunft gestaltenTokyo Electron ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter innovativer Produktionssysteme für die Halbleiterindustrie. Mit mehr als 18.000 Mitarbeitenden in 19 Ländern setzen wir Standards in der Entwicklung hochqualitativer Technologien und gestalten maßgeblich die Zukunft mit High-Tech-Anlagen für die nächste Chipgeneration.In Europa haben wir seit 1994 unsere Aktivitäten ausgeweitet und sind hier in 9 Ländern mit ca. 800 Mitarbeitenden tätig. Unser Geschäft konzentriert sich auf den Vertrieb und Service unserer Produktionsanlagen. Wir beraten und unterstützen unsere Kunden vor Ort, damit diese ihre Ziele in Chipdesign und Qualität bestmöglich erreichen. Eine gute Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden ist hierfür entscheiden, genauso wie unser intensiver Austausch mit unserem Hauptsitz in Japan und den weltweiten Produktionsstandorten von Tokyo Electron.Unsere deutsche Niederlassung, mit Sitz in Dresden, betreut die Installation, Wartung und Optimierung modernster TEL-Systeme in Deutschland. Wir sind stolz darauf, einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Halbleiterindustrie zu leisten – und wir suchen engagierte Talente, die mit uns wachsen möchten.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
